title: Blood debt must be paid in blood
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji stepped into the Sect Council Hall, everyone present would become witnesses to his revenge—including the old man seated on the highest throne.

text.content:
The vision shattered into countless fragments before Chen Ji's eyes, like Xuan paper crumpled by an invisible hand. He had never seen the Tianji Record lose control like this—that sharp pain of forced interference spread from his brow center through every limb, freezing him in place.

Blur. Nothing but blur.

But within that chaos, a silhouette stubbornly emerged. It was a face he would never mistake even in death—former Sect Master Ling Yuan, looking down at him from above, his eyes devoid of any emotional波动, as if gazing at a lamb waiting to be slaughtered.

"This is impossible..." Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, unrecognizable. His fingers dug into his palms, the pain of nails piercing flesh barely pulling him back to reality.

dialogue.content:
"Speak not, reveal not."

The ethereal form of Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul materialized beside Chen Ji, and that aged voice carried a rare heaviness: "Her—Chen Nian's existence itself interferes with Tianji divination. What you saw might only be one possibility."

"One possibility?" Chen Ji whirled around, eyes bloodshot, "Then what about my father? What about my fellow disciples who died? Are they also 'one possibility'?

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng offered no answer. He simply drifted toward the简陋 servant's quarters behind Chen Ji—where the遗物 of the senior brother who died in battle three days ago were stored. Sect servants had no right to formal disciple funerals; their belongings were usually disposed of arbitrarily, but Chen Ji had preserved them all under the pretext of "being from the same hometown."

For three years, he had been waiting for an opportunity.

And now, the opportunity had arrived.

Chen Ji took a deep breath and stepped into the small room filled with stale air. Moonlight filtered through the dilapidated window lattice, illuminating an old wooden box dusted with gray. He squatted down and slowly opened the box, revealing his senior brother's personal effects—a道袍 faded from countless washes, several worn notebooks, and a jade pendant soaked through with blood.

Chen Ji recognized this jade pendant. It was a communication artifact used within the sect, only Inner Sect disciples and above were qualified to wear it.

dialogue.content:
"Inject spiritual energy into it." Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's ear, "Blood stains interfere with ordinary detection techniques, but if you resonate your spiritual energy with the残留气息... you might see something deliberately hidden."

Chen Ji hesitated not. He gripped the jade pendant in his palm and slowly channeled spiritual energy. At first, nothing happened. Just as he was about to give up, a blinding golden light suddenly burst forth from the jade pendant—

It was an image sealed with advanced forbidden techniques.

text.content:
In the vision, a hunched figure knelt on the ground, blood staining half of his道袍. He lifted his head, revealing an aged yet familiar face—it was Chen Ji's father, the previous family head of the Chen family.

"Ling Yuan... you promised me..." the old man in the image shrieked desperately, "You promised that as long as we surrendered the Tianji Record Fragment, you would spare the Chen bloodline—"

A withered hand appeared at the image's edge, silencing the old man. The hand's owner wore a magnificent purple道袍. Though his features were invisible, Chen Ji recognized that iconic jade ring with perfect clarity.

Chen Ji's hands trembled.

He had seen that jade ring countless times. At every sect ceremony, every time the former Sect Master received disciples, that ring would refract blinding light under the sun. It was Ling Yuan's intimate possession, said to be a war trophy from his youth, never leaving his side.

"Do you see now?" Mo Xiansheng's voice was low, "This is the truth behind your father's death. The struggle for the Tianji Record's inheritance has never ceased."

dialogue.content:
The image continued.

In the vision, Ling Yuan slowly spoke, his voice ice-cold without a trace of warmth: "The Tianji Record chose your son over me. This is the greatest insult."

"He knows nothing—" the old man struggled to cry out.

"Therefore, he must die." Ling Yuan's hand rose, a fierce sword qi piercing through the old man's chest, "As must you, and the entire Chen family. Within three days, this sect will see the complete annihilation of the Chen family from this land."

text.content:
The image abruptly ended.

Chen Ji knelt before the wooden box, as if all strength had been drained from his body. His father's brutal death, his fellow disciples' extermination, those countless shattered nightmares in the dead of night over three years—all had been premeditated. From the very beginning, he had been merely a lamb fattened in a cage, waiting to be slaughtered.

No, that wasn't right.

Chen Ji slowly lifted his head, the grief and fury in his eyes gradually crystallizing into ice. He was no lamb. He was the hunter. And now, the prey had finally revealed a flaw.

choice.prompt: Ironclad evidence existed, but Ling Yuan was after all a Sect Master. Chen Ji had to make a choice—lurk and scheme, or lay all his cards on the table right now?

choices.text: Blood debt must be paid in blood
choices.description: Publicly reveal the truth before the sect's three-day Cleansing Battle, exposing Ling Yuan's crimes before everyone. Extremely high risk, but can maximize deterrence against the enemy.
choices.visible_cost: Lose strategic advantage, expose all底牌
choices.visible_reward: Public trial, legitimate right of revenge
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may act desperately and strike first

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, tucking the jade pendant into his chest. His voice was low and calm, yet carried a chilling intent that made spines tingle: "Mo Xiansheng, at the Cleansing Assembly three days from now, I will make the entire Tianqing Sect witness a trial."

"You must think carefully." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried an unusual solemnity, "Once made public, there is no going back."

choices.description: Continue to endure temporarily, first use this evidence to gather more筹码 in secret. Wait for Ling Yuan to reveal flaws in battle, then strike lethally. Lower risk, but requires much more time.
choices.visible_cost: Continue to endure, immense psychological pressure
choices.visible_reward: More complete evidence chain, safer timing for killing blow
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan senses something amiss, he may preemptively eliminate the threat

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes, forcibly suppressing the killing intent that threatened to burst forth. He had endured three years; a few more days wouldn't matter.

"What I want is not his death." He opened his eyes, cold light flashing in his gaze, "I want him to fall from grace, to kneel before the Chen family ancestral tomb and beg forgiveness from all the wandering souls."

Mo Xiansheng nodded slightly: "This is the grandeur a Tianji Record inheritor should possess."

choices.description: Not directly exposing the truth, but leaking the evidence to Ling Yuan's political enemies (such as Han Lie's faction from Xuanwu Sect), using their blades to kill. Lowest risk, but the enemy might not suffer enough.
choices.visible_cost: The initiative of revenge slips away
choices.visible_reward: Weakening Ling Yuan without shedding blood, by leveraging external forces
choices.risk_hint: Political enemies might use the evidence to blackmail Chen Ji

text.content:
A cold smile curved at the corner of Chen Ji's lips. Ling Yuan's favorite tactic was using others to kill, so why couldn't he repay the man in kind?

"Han Lie of Xuanwu Sect..." he murmured to himself, "Two tigers cannot share one mountain. If he learned of Ling Yuan's trump cards, his blade would probably be sharper than mine."

Mo Xiansheng remained silent for a moment: "This scheme is insidious yet effective. But you must prepare yourself—inviting wolves in is easy, driving them out is hard."

Night wind poured through the window lattice, causing the jade token in Chen Ji's hand to emit a faint glow. He stared at the sealed image within, his heart churning with surging hatred and cold calculation.

Three years of playing the废物, three years of hidden preparation. All the humiliation and suffering, at this moment, had been transformed into whetstones sharpening his blade.

He closed his eyes, his father's dying scream echoing in his ears. That was Ling Yuan's voice, the enemy he could never forget.

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly turned solemn, "Whatever choice you make, there is something I must tell you."

"What?"

"Ling Yuan... is not alone." Mo Xiansheng's phantom flickered slightly, "He has built his faction within the sect for decades, with loyalists in every corner. The decisive battle in three days—it's not a purge of the Demonic Path, but a purge of dissent. And the evidence in your hands is precisely what he fears most being exposed."

Chen Ji opened his eyes, the cold light in his gaze sharp as a blade: "So I must expose it before everyone. Let those blinded by him see clearly what kind of beast they have been serving."

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a long while before speaking: "Do you understand that once this evidence is made public, Ling Yuan will definitely counterattack? With his cultivation and power, even under the watchful eyes of all, he may still have means to turn the tables?"

Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, moonlight spilling over him, stretching his shadow long and cold. He lowered his gaze to his palm—where the Tianji Record's patterns were faintly glowing with heat.

"So I need more chips." he said, "Three days is enough time to weave a net from which he can never escape."

choice.prompt: Time is tight with three days remaining, Chen Ji must quickly gain support from key allies. How should he choose his breakthrough point?

choices.text: Contact the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow
choices.description: Su Qingyao is the only person within the sect who might have察觉 Chen Ji's true identity, and also the most likely group to believe him. Recruiting her can secure Inner Disciple support at critical moments.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing part of his strength, losing the advantage of disguise
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow as witness, enhancing credibility
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao's suspicious nature might lead her to investigate in reverse

text.content:
Su Qingyao.

The cold as ice figure surfaced in Chen Ji's mind. Three times she had approached the truth, three times he had skillfully deflected her. This woman was terrifyingly sharp, yet had unknowingly developed a subtle trust in him.

"She needs to know the truth." Chen Ji自语道, "At least part of it."

choices.description: Ye Qing has a secret cooperation agreement with Chen Ji—her 'Demon Path Mist' can conceal the Tianji Record's aura. The Demon Path's involvement at a critical moment would place Ling Yuan in a predicament of being attacked from both front and back.
choices.visible_cost: Bearing the stain of colluding with the Demon Path
choices.visible_reward: Gain support from the Demon Path forces, multi-front warfare advantage
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, may be viewed as betraying the sect

text.content:
Ye Qing.

The Demon Path Saintess used as a chess piece by the Holy Sect—her situation paralleled Chen Ji's. Their cooperation had never been built on trust, but on a common enemy.

"The chaos in three days is her opportunity, and mine." Chen Ji's gaze flickered, "If I can thrust another knife into Ling Yuan's back..."

Outside the window, the night was deep and dark, with no starlight or moonlight.

Chen Ji tucked the jade token close to his body, turned, and pushed open the door. Moonlight flowed like liquid silver, illuminating his young face already weathered by hardships. For three years, he had walked the lowest rungs of Tianqing Sect under the guise of a废物, enduring cold gazes and mockery.

But after tonight, everything would change.

"Father..." he raised his head toward the distant night sky, his voice low yet firm, "Watch and see. The blood debt owed to our Chen family, I will collect every last drop."

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng's phantom materialized behind Chen Ji, the ancient voice carrying rare praise: "The Tianji Record chose you, and indeed did not choose wrongly."

"But remember this." His tone shifted, "Ling Yuan has held the position of Sect Master for decades—he is no ordinary man. His hidden trump cards may be more than you imagine. In these three days, variables abound."

Chen Ji nodded slightly, the cold light in his eyes intensifying: "Variables? I'd like to see whether his trump cards are harder, or my blade is faster."

text.content:
He strode into the night, his figure soon vanishing among the tiered rooflines of Tianqing Sect. The decisive battle of the sect's great purge three days hence would be the stage for his revenge. And before that, he still had far too much to do.

First step, persuade Su Qingyao.

Second step, contact Ye Qing.

Third step—

When that net was completely woven, it would be Ling Yuan's death sentence.

The night wind howled past, as if playing the prelude to the coming storm of blood and slaughter.

choice.prompt: Before officially taking action, Chen Ji needs to determine a key strategy. How should he position himself in the great purge tournament?

choices.description: Revealing the evidence at the climax of the final battle, exposing Ling Yuan's crimes before all members of the three great sects. Let the truth spread in the most explosive way possible.
choices.visible_cost: May face being surrounded, highest risk of exposure
choices.visible_reward: Most shocking effect, completely destroys Ling Yuan's prestige
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may make a desperate move at the last moment

text.content:
Public Exposure.

This is the simplest and most brutal method, yet also the most effective. What Chen Ji has always wanted is not assassination, but to utterly destroy Ling Yuan's reputation. When everyone witnesses the true face of this highly respected old Sect Master, he will have a hundred mouths and still be unable to defend himself.

"On the battlefield three days later, I will show the entire cultivation world what it means to pay a blood debt with blood."

choices.description: Not rushing for the moment, but gradually releasing rumors before the final battle, letting the voices questioning Ling Yuan grow louder and louder. By the day of the final battle, Ling Yuan will already be abandoned by all.
choices.visible_cost: Time-consuming, unexpected changes may occur during this period
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan's prestige crumbles gradually, making him easier to completely defeat
choices.risk_hint: Information may leak, startling the snake

text.content:
Step by Step.

Chen Ji deeply knows that truly clever revenge is not killing with a single strike, but letting the enemy slowly perish in despair. Three days is enough for him to set up an inescapable net right under Ling Yuan's nose.

"I want him to personally watch his foundation crumble piece by piece." A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips, "This is true blood debt repayment."

Chen Ji withdrew his thoughts, his gaze becoming unprecedentedly resolute. For three years, he had survived as a 'waste', enduring countless humiliations without ever defending himself. All his unwillingness and fury were buried deep in his heart, transforming into nutrients nourishing the Tianji Record.

And now, the fertilizer was finally bearing fruit.

He raised his head, gazing toward where the old Sect Master was. The lanterns there blazed brightly as Ling Yuan made final preparations for the battle three days later. Perhaps he was still gloating, thinking everything was under his control.

But he had no idea that the countdown to death had already begun.

The Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's embrace grew faintly warm, as if sensing its master's resolve. It was a strange sensation—containing both a defiance against fate and a longing for vengeance. The Sect cleansing battle three days later would become the moment Chen Ji finalized the chess game he had set up.

And Ling Yuan was merely the final piece on his chessboard awaiting slaughter.

Night wind howled, dispersing the last wisp of dark clouds from the horizon. Moonlight fell upon the mortal world once more, illuminating Chen Ji's departing silhouette, as well as the impending storm of blood and slaughter.
